chat:en:what documents do i need to get:
Documents for Get the home-based vocational licence:
- Property owner approval form (only if you rent the place)
- GAM declaration and pledge form
- Trader registration certificate (commercial register)
- Title deed of the property (copy)
- Building documents: occupancy permit, construction licence, building specifications certificate and zoning sheet
- GAM rent-contract certificate (only if you rent the place)
- JFDA food processing and label approval (only for food businesses)
- National ID card
chat:en:can i run a bakery from home: Yes. Food activities allowed from home include home-baked goods (cakes, pastries, biscuits, sweets), jams, pickles, jameed, prepared vegetables, and herbs and legumes, all made by hand. After registering as a trader, join the Amman Chamber of Industry (40 JOD if your capital is under 10,000 JOD), then get JFDA approval (Jordan Food and Drug Administration: 200 JOD for one food type, including lab tests, in 7-10 days), then the home-based vocational licence from GAM (20-50 JOD). Food businesses in Amman can't receive customers at home.
chat:ar:كم رسوم رخصه المهن للمشروع المنز: الحصول على رخصة المهن المنزلية: 20 إلى 50 ديناراً رسم أساسي حسب نوع المهنة. تُدفع لدى أمانة عمّان الكبرى (رخص المهن).
chat:ar:هل لازم اسجل بالضمان اذا ما عندي: نعم. الاشتراك في الضمان الاجتماعي إلزامي لمالك المؤسسة الفردية الذي يعمل فيها حتى لو كان يعمل وحده، ولكل عامل عندما يكون لديك عامل واحد أو أكثر. تُدفع الاشتراكات شهرياً خلال 15 يوماً من الشهر التالي. التسجيل مجاني: احصل على الرقم إلكترونياً ثم فعّل الحساب لدى المؤسسة بنموذج ضابط الارتباط وختم المنشأة.
chat:en:what is the minimum capital for: The minimum capital for an LLC is 1 JOD. A sole proprietorship declares at least 1,000 JOD, with no deposit required. General and limited partnerships need at least 1,000 JOD.
chat:en:what is the income tax rate for: I don't have verified information about income tax rates; they depend on your business type and income. Please ask the Income and Sales Tax Department (ISTD).
